text: “我什么都不知道！什么都不知道！”查理极为激动地大叫。你费了些工夫才让她平静下来。等她安静后，你转向诺曼，请他安排人手寻找伯纳德。
你回头看了一眼闷闷不乐的查理。你确实很需要她的野外生存本领，但你能信任她吗？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 15
text: “I know nothing! Nothing!” Charlie bellows, deeply agitated. You calm her with some difficulty. Once she subsides, you turn to Norman and ask him to arrange a search for Bernard.
You glance back at the sullen Charlie. You could really use her woodcraft skills. But can you depend on her?
